sections.content:
Upstream Tech is a climate technology company that uses satellites and machine learning to help organizations manage and monitor natural resources. We have two Software as a Service products, Lens and HydroForecast.
Are you interested in working with us, but don’t see an open role that’s right for you? Drop your resume and cover letter here to get in our system. We'll reach out if we have relevant opportunities we think you should apply to in the future.

sections.heading: You’d be a good fit if
sections.content:
You have great communication skills, and want to share your expertise through mentorship.
You are excited to introduce new patterns and improve work processes to make your team happy and efficient.
You’re pragmatic, solutions-oriented, and want to get things done without sacrificing quality.
You are humble, and have empathy for customers and teammates.
You believe that giving and receiving honest, direct feedback helps everyone to grow.
You enjoy working on teams, and believe a variety of skills and perspectives create the best products.
You want to work at a small, impact-focused company. We measure our success with a triple bottom line and put our principles before profits.
We are proud to offer great benefits like 4 weeks of paid vacation and good health, dental, vision, and life insurance plans. We want our team to live full lives outside of work.

sections.heading: Location
sections.content: Remote, in a US time zone. We conduct business using technologies like Slack and video conferencing. We host an annual in-person trip to work, bond, and celebrate our successes.

sections.heading: Our hiring process
sections.content:
In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.
Upstream Tech is committed to building, supporting, and growing a diverse team. We have a standardized interview process designed to reduce individual bias, and use structured pay scales to provide equitable compensation. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
